text: 欧盟自11月1日起对低价值进口商品征收2欧元手续费，此前已于7月开始征收3欧元关税。商务部新闻发言人黄玲在5日举行的例行新闻发布会上对此表示，中方高度关注欧方有关新规。跨境电商作为国际贸易的新业态、新模式，为全球企业和消费者提供了多元化选择。希望欧方审慎评估相关政策影响，为中欧在电商等领域合作创造有利条件。（新华社）
text_en: Since November 1, the EU has imposed a 2-euro fee on low-value imported goods, after having imposed a 3-euro tariff starting in July. Ministry of Commerce spokesperson Huang Ling said at a regular press conference on the 5th that China is highly concerned about the EU's new rules. As a new form and model of international trade, cross-border e-commerce provides diversified choices for global companies and consumers. China hopes the EU will carefully assess the impact of the relevant policies and create favorable conditions for China-EU cooperation in e-commerce and other areas. (Xinhua News Agency)
